plain_text:
Page 1 
SOUTH BURLINGTON 
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT COMMITTEE MEETING 
November 10, 2026  
 
The South Burlington Economic Development Committee held a regular meeting at 5:30 PM 
in Room 301 of the South Burlington City Hall, 180 Market Street, South Burlington and by 
remote participation.  
Members present:  Nicole LaBrecque (Chair), Chris Carrigan (Vice Chair), Paige Brochu, 
John Burton, Rebecca Killian, Brad Krompf, and Jason Mintz  
Members absent:  Harold Hershberg, Emma Boardman-Shouldice.  
Also present:  Ilona Blanchard, South Burlington Community Development Director 
(Committee Staff), Andrew Chalnick, City Council (Council Liaison), Elizabeth  
1. The meeting was called to order by Nicole LaBrecque, Chair, at 5:33 p.m. Emergency 
exit procedures were reviewed. The agenda was approved (moved by John Burton, 
seconded by Brad Krompf) unanimously.  
2. Comments from the Public. Public member joined and did not have questions or 
comment.  
3. Review and Approve Minutes from Prior Meetings 
a. October 13, 2026. The draft minutes were approved (moved by John Burton, seconded 
by Brad Krompf). 
4. Updates: 
a. Nicole LaBrecque (Chair) 
 San Remo Drive: Overview of property proved to have limited negative 
findings 
 Monthly review for new permits discussed. Suggestion to have new 
Economic Development Director look at process and provide support.  
 Due to limited attendance, December meeting will be canceled. 
Concurrently, Alex Armani-Munn will reach out to each committee 
working group to meet individually.  
b. Staff (Ilona Blanchard): 
 New Economic Development Director hired: Alex Armani-Munn is on 
board and working part-time until December. Unavailable for this
Economic Development Committee Meeting Minutes | Page 2 
meeting and looking forward to joining. Shares his support of this 
committee and its historical work. 
 Chittenden Area Transportation Management: Study regarding employee 
and employer access to transportation and sustainability. Findings will 
most likely be presented at next meeting. 
 November 19th:  
8:30 AM - South Burlington City Collaborative – hosting three 
speakers in library in the morning. Focus on experiences with 
being a retailer in this community and how community can further 
support businesses. 
5:30 PM – Blaine Newton, CIO, Beta Technologies – Spotlight 
802 in auditorium 
 Beta Technologies is working on building a local supply chain for 
composites. 
 November 23rd – Garden Street North is opening to the public.  
c. Member Committee Activities: 
o Chris: UVM Professional and Continuing Education will launch online 
degree program by end of next year. Spring, there will be another AI 
certificate program and hospitality certificate program. Grant for 
biotechnology program, program was sold out. 
o Nicole: UVM Board of Trustees authorized restarting of the event 
center/arena 
o Paige: Grant opportunity with SBC3 for website/dashboard to navigate 
the City. Preproposal due December 20th. 
 
d. Council (Andrew Chalnick): 
o Agreement was approved to seek agreement with Beta Technologies 
with the pump station. Beta will seek to upgrade it to have additional 
capacity with the goal of the city buying out the delta over time. 
o City Council had a discussion regarding housing needs. Agreed to move 
forward with needs assessments for low and medium scenarios for 
housing units. Assessment will be in partnership with CCRPC. 
o Housing Trust received $250k grant for energy improvements to housing 
units on Dorset. 
o O’Brien put forward a proposal to the city for a CHIP proposal to have 
future tax revenue in 43 new houses fund infrastructure for property. 
Asked to bring back additional information for further discussion.
Economic Development Committee Meeting Minutes | Page 3 
o City looking to pursue initiatives with State legislature that support City 
goals. City Council is building list of initiatives to prioritize. 
 
5. Economic Development Strategic Plan 
a. Work Session: Join or Die (movie). November 15th, 2:30-3:30, opportunity to 
attend movie screening regarding importance of engaging with and investing in 
community through volunteering and participating in civic and community 
groups. 
b. Working Groups Report: none 
6. Onboarding and Introductions: Working Groups committed to meeting with Alex to 
support onboarding by giving Alex a common understanding of the work each group has 
done to date.  
7. Potential Future Guests 
a. Kevin Chu (Vermont Futures Project). Committee agreed to invite Kevin in 
January or February 
b. Invite U-Mall  
c. Presentation on multipurpose center 
d. UVM  
e. SB3C 
f. Hello Burlington 
g. Committee agreed to lay out list of potential guests for 2027, utilizing the 
strategic plan to identify guest speakers 
8. Other Business 
9. Adjournment 
The meeting was adjourned at 6:29 (moved by Paige Brochu, seconded by Jason Mintz). 
Bradley L. Krompf,
